content: The topic of question generation, initially motivated for educational purposes, is tackled by designing many complex rules for specific question types BIBREF4, BIBREF23. Heilman2010GoodQS improve rule-based question generation by introducing a statistical ranking model. First, they remove extraneous information in the sentence to transform it into a simpler one, which can be transformed easily into a succinct question with predefined sets of general rules. Then they adopt an overgenerate-and-rank approach to select the best candidate considering several features.
